replacement.write_credential: dedicated value-only systemd credentials; no sovereign key reuse

bindings.DB: PostgreSQL schema cf_echo_live_chat with tenant-scoped parameterized queries
bindings.CACHE: PostgreSQL-backed idempotency, session, and rate-limit state
bindings.ANALYTICS: PostgreSQL daily aggregates plus value-free structured service logs
bindings.ECHO_API_KEY: dedicated admin bearer credential loaded from systemd credentials
bindings.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: optional Stripe API credential loaded from a dedicated systemd credential; webhook signing uses a separate value-only credential
bindings.ENGINE_RUNTIME: bounded private service adapter with fail-closed timeout
bindings.SHARED_BRAIN: Sentinel-compatible bounded private service adapter with graceful degradation

state_recovery.policy: Preserve all eleven rescue-pipeline TEXT tables immutably as legacy_*_text_v1, create a typed runtime schema, and import the one recovered widget row without inventing customer content.
state_recovery.delta: FORGE already contained the eleven D1 exports as nullable TEXT staging tables: ten empty and one widgets row. The migration renames them to legacy_*_text_v1, revokes runtime access, imports the widget into the typed table, generates a new public widget key, and creates a clearly labeled structural parent because the recovered tenant_id is absent.

deliberate_deltas: Administrative and agent routes require a dedicated constant-time bearer credential.
Visitor routes use signed, tenant-bound visitor sessions rather than trusting client-supplied tenant identifiers.
The Stripe webhook fails closed unless its dedicated signing credential is provisioned.
CORS is restricted to explicitly configured widget origins; wildcard credentialed CORS is forbidden.
Cloudflare service bindings are replaced by bounded loopback/private-cluster HTTP adapters.
The Worker scheduled handler is replaced by a hardened systemd timer with a single-flight database lock.
The recovered D1 widget is imported from the preserved staging row; no customer content is synthesized.
